# Welcome

Hi! I'm Claire Liu. Welcome to my personal website.

I am an MPH student in Biostatistics at Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health, pursing certificate of Advanced epidemiology.

I am currently a research assistant at Weill Cornell Medicine, where I work on a health equity project examining patient housing instability, healthcare access, and geographic patterns. I also serve as a teaching assistant for Statistical Computing with SAS at Columbia.

My interests include biostatistics, epidemiology, public health data science, health equity, and health analysis related to physical exercise. I am especially interested in using statistical methods to better understand health disparities and support evidence-based public health research.
